scientific_question: Given 32 paid do-intervention effects rather than all 64, can a source-blind partial adapter program only genuinely witnessed nuisance-invariant coordinates into the unchanged native Yggdrasil NKR04 checkpoint, preserve safe abstention on unsupported action choices, and reject contradiction without claiming universal nuisance independence?

mechanism.input: Exact-pinned canonical ASCII WSP156 source-free fixture with predeclared separate action_bit and nuisance_bit among 6 raw do factors, slot 0..15, sorted unique raw masks with one actual observed_do binary outcome and unique source ref each; 1..64 effects. Reject owner-qualified or inferred sources, duplicate refs/masks, invalid bit roles, bad pin/schema/cold checkpoint.
mechanism.mapping: Four remaining bit positions sorted. For each of 16 contexts and 2 actions, only two charged source rows differing in declared nuisance bit can jointly certify one native (slot,context,action) evidence record. One charged variant is INSUFFICIENT; zero variants absent. Two conflicting effects -> reject entire transaction. All inferred/unwitnessed coordinates remain unstaged.
mechanism.native: Use unchanged native_evidence_compiler.stage_native_bundle and NativeRelationMemory; no new state store or accepted model. Export explicit immutable certified-context readout ONLY where current source has complete nuisance witness for BOTH actions at a context. Do not use native raw predict() or fallback choose() as evidence of unsupported causal effect. Source and candidate digests plus certified/readout provenance in receipt.
mechanism.prior: Optional staged prior native checkpoint, verified on restore. New certified readout derives only from the current pinned source; preexisting same-value records can count toward native deduplication but cannot silently certify a new source's uncharged actions. Verify atomic conflict rejection and byte-exact cold restore.
mechanism.knowledge_limit: Native checkpoint may numerically interpolate unsupported contexts; such predictions MUST NEVER be exposed as verified results. Any wholly unobserved pair may hide an adverse unseen sixth-bit law, so only local observed certification is justified.
